sections.title: Building the page
sections.what: Escapes the text and builds table rows for restored evidence and for unresolved values, then writes the page and prints a line.
sections.why: Likely reason: escaping keeps quoted text from breaking the page or being read as code.
sections.watch_out: The layout is embedded in this file, so any layout change is made here.

summary: Builds an HTML page from the committed evidence repair results, listing the restored evidence and the unresolved values.
purpose: It gives reviewers a readable view of which values were linked to evidence and which were left unresolved.
why: Likely reason: a readable record of an earlier repair run for review.
how: It reads the committed results, escapes the text, builds one table row per restored evidence item and one per unresolved value, writes the page, and prints a line.
risks: It only reads and writes report files, so it does not change project data. It assumes each record has the fields it uses, and the page template is cut off in this excerpt.
debug: If the script fails on reading, check that committed.json exists and is valid JSON. An empty table means the matching list is empty in that file.
